note.question: What role does cournot competition play in networked markets?
note.overview: The paper considers a model of competition among firms that produce a homogeneous good in a networked environment. We provide a characterization of the production quantities at the unique equilibrium of the resulting game for any given network. The paper's results identify a novel connection between the equilibrium outcome and supply paths in the underlying network structure.
